dedupe_keys.name: cofactor sbhub oslo hourly sub metered energy use data from 48 public school buildings in oslo norway

description: COFACTOR-SBHUB Oslo is a dataset published by SINTEF from energy measurements supplied by Oslobygg KF. It contains hourly energy use and local weather data from 48 public school buildings in Oslo. Each building has a human-readable delimited file with building metadata, main-meter measurements and sub-meter time series. All buildings have sub-metered heating; some also have domestic hot water and photovoltaic generation measurements. The series span 2012 to 2024 overall, with one to eleven years of data per building. The versioned, open-access data product includes the building files, plots and a README. DataCite lists Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 for the dataset. Access is free through the SINTEF repository, with no registration stated. The measurements were selected for reliable heating sub-meters, then relabelled and quality checked, so they do not represent every Oslo school. The data can support building-demand calibration, heat-load disaggregation, load forecasting and electricity or district-heating grid planning. It is related to the catalogued COFACTOR residential measurements from Trondheim.
